topic: Types of Rocks and Rock Formation
key_concepts: Rocks can be described by texture, grain size, color, hardness, and toughness.
Texture can be classified as rough or smooth.
Grain size varies among rock samples.
Rock color may include multiple colors and patterns.
Hardness can be compared by scratching rocks against each other.
Toughness can be compared by observing damage after dropping rocks.
Rocks can be classified into igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic types.
Rock type can be identified from observable features such as patterns and materials.
Different rock types have distinct characteristics.
Rocks may have possible uses for humans and purposes in the environment.
